submittedInput.content: These are three separate tasks I chose myself: install the scheduled update in my device settings; enter my parcel collection PIN on the locker keypad; and settle yesterday's agreed S$9 lunch share with my colleague when we meet. No contact asks for remote control, a bank login code, a new recipient or an urgent transfer.

evidence.title: Keep banking credentials private
evidence.detail: DBS advises against giving another person banking credentials, one-time passwords or Digital Token approvals. This source concerns account authentication; it does not classify ordinary parcel-collection codes. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.

evidence.title: Check unexpected technical-support requests
evidence.detail: SPF describes technical-support scams that ask people to download remote-access software or grant control of their device. Confirm an unexpected support request through the software provider’s official channels before following its instructions. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.
